# VoidFrame UI — Full API Reference

> Dark monochrome React UI framework. Terminal-brutalist. Data-dense. Zero border-radius. Monospace-first.

> 500+ components, 76 hooks, 100 utilities

Generated: 2026-05-05

---

## Components

### Primitives

#### AccessibleIcon
Source: `src/primitives/AccessibleIcon.tsx`

Wrap a decorative SVG/glyph with an accessible label. The icon itself is marked `aria-hidden`, and the label renders in a `VisuallyHidden` sibling. The forwarded ref targets the wrapped icon element (typically an `<svg>`), so consumers can measure or focus-control it through the primitive.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| label | string | Yes | — | Accessible name for screen readers. |

#### DismissableLayer
Source: `src/primitives/DismissableLayer.tsx`

Handles Escape-to-dismiss and click-outside-to-dismiss for overlays. Stacks correctly with nested layers: only the topmost responds to Escape. Does NOT trap focus — compose with `<FocusScope>` for full modal semantics.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| onEscapeKeyDown | ((e: KeyboardEvent) => void) | No | — | Fires on Escape if this layer is topmost. |
| onPointerDownOutside | ((e: PointerEvent) => void) | No | — | Fires on pointer-down outside the layer. |
| onDismiss | (() => void) | No | — | Shorthand: fires for both Escape and outside pointer-down. |

#### ErrorBoundary
Source: `src/primitives/ErrorBoundary.tsx`

Class-based error boundary. Catches render/effect errors in descendants, renders `fallback`, and exposes `reset()` to recover.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| fallback | ReactNode \| ((error: Error, reset: () => void) => ReactNode) | No | — | Fallback UI. Either a ReactNode (static) or a render function receiving `(error, reset)` for interactive recovery. |
| onError | ((error: Error, info: ErrorInfo) => void) | No | — | Invoked when a descendant throws. |
| resetKeys | unknown[] | No | — | When any value in this array changes identity, the boundary auto-resets. Useful when the underlying cause is tied to a prop or route. |

#### FocusScope
Source: `src/primitives/FocusScope.tsx`

Trap Tab focus inside a region. Used by Modal, Drawer, Sheet, ConfirmDialog. The rendered `<div>` is the focus boundary. Focusable descendants are discovered via a query selector (see `FOCUSABLE`) plus visibility filtering.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| trapped | boolean | No | true | When true (default), Tab/Shift+Tab are trapped inside this container. |
| loop | boolean | No | true | Loop from last → first (and first → last) when at the boundary. |
| autoFocus | boolean | No | true | Focus the first focusable child (or `target`) on mount. |
| restoreFocus | boolean | No | true | Return focus to the element that was focused before mount, on unmount. |

#### HydrationBoundary
Source: `src/primitives/HydrationBoundary.tsx`

Suspends a subtree from SSR. Useful for components that inherently can't render server-side (canvas, measurements, time-of-day) without introducing hydration mismatches.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| fallback | ReactNode | No | null | Rendered on the server and until the first client render lands. |

#### LiveRegion
Source: `src/primitives/LiveRegion.tsx`

Declarative `aria-live` region. Consumers drive announcements via `message`. For imperative announcements (Toast queues etc.) use `useAnnouncer()`.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| message | string | No | — | Message text. Setting it announces to screen readers. |
| politeness | enum | No | polite |  |
| clearAfter | number | No | — | Clear the message this many ms after it's announced. |

#### Portal
Source: `src/primitives/Portal.tsx`

Render children into a detached DOM node. Returns `null` until mount so SSR matches the client HTML.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| container | HTMLElement \| null | No | — | Target container. Defaults to `document.body`. |
| inheritTheme | boolean | No | true | When true, the portaled subtree is wrapped in a `<ThemeScope>` mirroring the nearest ancestor's resolved theme. Defaults to `true` so portaled overlays (Dialog, DrawerV2, Menu, ContextMenu, Tooltip, Popover, Toaster, etc.) inherit the active theme even when: - the consumer ran `<VoidframeProvider scope="root">` (no documentElement write), and / or - a nested `<ThemeScope themeName="…">` overrode theme for a subtree that contains the portal trigger. Set to `false` for portaled content that needs to render outside the voidframe theme cascade (very rare — e.g. embedding a third-party widget with its own theming). |

#### Presence
Source: `src/primitives/Presence.tsx`

Keep a child mounted long enough to play its CSS exit animation. The child is expected to: 1. Read its `data-state` attribute (`"open"` or `"closed"`) for CSS targeting. 2. Define `animation` / `transition` for each state. Presence watches `animationend` / `transitionend` on the child, so ensure the exit rule sets a real animation or transition — otherwise the child unmounts synchronously.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| present | boolean | Yes | — | When false, the child unmounts *after* finishing its CSS exit animation. |

#### RovingFocusGroup
Source: `src/primitives/RovingFocusGroup.tsx`

Coordinates arrow-key navigation across a group of focusable children. Only one child is tab-reachable at a time (the "current" one); arrow keys move focus within the group. Used by Tabs, Menu, Toolbar, RadioGroup, Stepper.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| orientation | enum | No | horizontal |  |
| loop | boolean | No | true |  |
| value | string | No | — | Controlled current-focus value. |
| defaultValue | string | No | — |  |
| onValueChange | ((value: string) => void) | No | — |  |

#### RovingFocusGroup.Item
Source: `src/primitives/RovingFocusGroup.tsx`

A single rovable item. Spread its props onto the element you want focused.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| value | string | Yes | — |  |
| enabled | boolean | No | true | When false, this item is skipped by arrow-key nav and is not tab-reachable. |

#### ScrollLock
Source: `src/primitives/ScrollLock.tsx`

Freeze the document body's scroll while mounted (and `enabled`). Composes cleanly under nested locks — all must be released before the body unlocks. Compensates for the scrollbar so content doesn't shift.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| enabled | boolean | No | true |  |

#### Separator
Source: `src/primitives/Separator.tsx`

Headless separator with correct ARIA semantics. Unstyled by default — size/color come from the consumer.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| orientation | enum | No | horizontal |  |
| decorative | boolean | No | false | When true, the separator is purely visual (role="none") so it doesn't introduce semantics. When false (default), uses role="separator" with aria-orientation. |

#### SkipToContent
Source: `src/primitives/SkipToContent.tsx`

Keyboard-only skip link. Hidden visually until focused (Tab as the first interactive element on the page), then renders as a prominent button. Jumps focus to the target (typically `<main id="main">`). Place as the first element inside your page root.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| href | string | Yes | — | Fragment or ID of the main content target. |

#### Slot
Source: `src/primitives/Slot.tsx`

Renders its single child element with merged props from the parent. Rules: - Exactly one child element required (dev-warns otherwise). - Event handlers compose: parent's fires after child's. - `style` and `className` merge (child wins on conflict for `style`, className strings concatenate). - `ref` is merged with the child's existing ref.

#### Transition
Source: `src/primitives/Transition.tsx`

High-level enter/exit animation wrapper. Composes `<Presence>` with a predefined animation type. The child element receives a merged `className` and `data-state`: - `data-state="open"` when entering / entered - `data-state="closed"` when exiting / exited CSS rules in `@/css/components/transition.css` target those states per animation type. For custom animations, use `<Presence>` directly and write your own CSS.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| show | boolean | Yes | — | Show the child. When false, the child unmounts after its exit animation completes. |
| type | enum | No | fade | Named animation. Maps to `.vf-transition--*` CSS rules. |
| duration | number | No | — | Override both enter and exit duration (ms). |
| enterDuration | number | No | — | Override enter duration only (ms). |
| exitDuration | number | No | — | Override exit duration only (ms). |

#### VisuallyHidden
Source: `src/primitives/VisuallyHidden.tsx`

Visually hides its children while keeping them accessible to assistive tech. Use for icon-only button labels, skip links, form hints, and live regions.

### Core

#### Badge
Source: `src/components/Badge.tsx`

Small categorical label for status chips, counts, and highlights. Tone (`neutral`/`success`/`danger`/`warning`/`info`), variant (`solid`/`outline`/ `ghost`/`subtle`), and size knobs. Supports a leading dot glyph, optional icon, dismissible close button, and a `count` + `overflowCount` counter mode.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| color | string | No | — | Accent color (hex). Sets `--vf-accent`. |
| variant | enum | No | solid |  |
| tone | enum | No | neutral |  |
| size | enum | No | md |  |
| dot | boolean | No | — | Render a leading dot glyph instead of full background. |
| icon | ReactNode | No | — |  |
| dismissible | boolean | No | — | Renders a close button after the label. |
| onDismiss | (() => void) | No | — | Callback when the close button is clicked. |
| count | number | No | — | When set, renders the count as the label (ignoring children). |
| overflowCount | number | No | — | When count exceeds this, displays `{overflowCount}+`. |
| asChild | boolean | No | — |  |

#### Button
Source: `src/components/Button.tsx`

Primary interactive button. Five variants (`solid`, `outline`, `ghost`, `subtle`, `destructive`), four sizes including `icon` (square 1:1 aspect), tone vocabulary (`neutral` / `info` / `success` / `danger` / `warning`) mirroring Badge/AlertV2/Card, optional `iconLeft` / `iconRight`, loading spinner, and polymorphic `asChild` for slot-style composition. Memoized so re-renders are skipped when props are referentially stable.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| onClick | ((event: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement, MouseEvent>) => void) | No | — | Click handler. Receives the native `MouseEvent` so consumers can call `stopPropagation()` / `preventDefault()` when the button is nested inside a clickable row or card. (Prior to 1.1.0 the signature was `() => void`; the event param is additive — existing zero-arg handlers keep working.) |
| disabled | boolean | No | — |  |
| variant | enum | No | outline |  |
| accent | string | No | — | Accent color for `solid` and `subtle` variants. Sets `--vf-accent`. |
| tone | enum | No | — | Semantic tone. Adds `data-tone="…"` + `vf-button--tone-…` class and, for `danger`/`warning`/`success`, primes `--vf-accent` to the matching token so solid/subtle variants render in-tone without manual `accent=`. Mirrors the Badge/AlertV2/Card tone vocabulary. |
| size | enum | No | md |  |
| active | boolean | No | — |  |
| loading | boolean | No | — | When true, renders a spinner before children and disables the button. |
| iconLeft | ReactNode | No | — | Icon rendered before children. Replaced by spinner when loading. |
| iconRight | ReactNode | No | — | Icon rendered after children. |
| asChild | boolean | No | — | Render through `<Slot>` and merge styles onto a single child element. |

#### ButtonGroup
Source: `src/components/Button.tsx`

Horizontal group of buttons with unified borders. Accepts `Button` or `IconButton` children and exposes `attached` / `size` / `variant` props.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| options | ButtonGroupOption[] | Yes | — |  |
| value | string | Yes | — |  |
| onValueChange | (key: string) => void | Yes | — |  |
| accent | string | No | — |  |
| size | enum | No | md |  |

#### Card
Source: `src/components/Card.tsx`

Brutalist content container with a bordered surface. Optional `title` / `subtitle` / `headerRight` header slot and `actions` footer slot. Use `hoverable` for a lift-on-hover effect, `monospace` for log/code content, or `asChild` to render a custom element (link, button) while keeping card styling.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| title | string | No | — |  |
| subtitle | string | No | — |  |
| headerRight | ReactNode | No | — |  |
| padding | number | No | — |  |
| hoverable | boolean | No | — | Adds hover elevation effect via CSS class. |
| monospace | boolean | No | — | When true, renders the card body in a monospace font stack with a slightly reduced size. Intended for CI log output, prompt dumps, raw JSON traces, code snippets pasted into a card, etc. |
| actions | ReactNode | No | — | Renders in a footer actions slot after children. |
| collapsible | boolean | No | — | When true, renders the card header as a clickable disclosure toggle so the body collapses in-place. Mirrors `Sidebar.Section` / `Accordion` collapse semantics without reparenting the content. Controllable via `open` + `onOpenChange`; uncontrolled via `defaultOpen`. |
| open | boolean | No | — | Controlled open state (only meaningful when `collapsible`). |
| defaultOpen | boolean | No | true | Uncontrolled initial open state (only meaningful when `collapsible`). Default true. |
| onOpenChange | ((open: boolean) => void) | No | — | Fires when the open state changes. |
| asChild | boolean | No | — |  |

#### CopyButton
Source: `src/components/CopyButton.tsx`

Clipboard button that writes `text` on click and flips to a "Copied" confirmation state for `copiedDuration` ms. Emits `onCopy(text)` on success, `onError(err)` on clipboard-API failure. Matches Button's canonical variant vocabulary. Memoized.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| onCopy | ((text: string) => void) | No | — | Fires after a successful clipboard write with the copied text. |
| onError | ((error: Error) => void) | No | — | Fires when the clipboard write fails. |
| text | string | Yes | — | The text to copy to the clipboard. |
| label | string | No | Copy | Label shown in default (idle) state. Defaults to "Copy". |
| copiedLabel | string | No | Copied | Label shown after a successful copy. Defaults to "Copied". |
| copiedDuration | number | No | 2000 | Duration in ms the "copied" state is shown. Defaults to 2000. |
| variant | enum | No | outline |  |
| size | enum | No | md |  |
| tone | enum | No | — | Semantic tone. Mirrors Button/IconButton tone vocabulary — emits `data-tone` and primes `--vf-accent` when no explicit accent is supplied. |
| disabled | boolean | No | — |  |

#### Divider
Source: `src/components/Text.tsx`

Horizontal or vertical rule used to separate groups of content. Optional `label` renders a centred caption break.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| color | string | No | — |  |
| spacing | number | No | — | Vertical margin in px. Defaults to `sp6` (12px) via CSS. |
| label | ReactNode | No | — | Optional inline label centered on the rule (horizontal only). |
| orientation | enum | No | horizontal | Orientation. Default "horizontal". |

#### Text
Source: `src/components/Text.tsx`

Generic text element. Size, color, transform are CSS-driven; `color`, `weight`, and `spacing` come through as inline-style overrides because they are arbitrary per-instance values. Supports polymorphic `as` for choosing an intrinsic tag, or `asChild` to merge styling onto a consumer-provided element (e.g. a router link).

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| size | TextSize | No | md |  |
| color | string | No | — | Override text color. |
| weight | number | No | — |  |
| spacing | number | No | — |  |
| upper | boolean | No | — | Uppercase transform. |
| as | enum | No | span |  |
| asChild | boolean | No | — | Render through `<Slot>` and merge props onto a single child element. |

### Layout

#### AppShell
Source: `src/components/AppShell.tsx`

The top-level layout shell combining a sidebar, header, and main content area. Provides a consistent application chrome with configurable sizing for each region.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| header | ReactNode | No | — |  |
| sidebar | ReactNode | No | — |  |
| rightPanel | ReactNode | No | — |  |
| footer | ReactNode | No | — |  |
| sidebarWidth | string \| number | No | 240 | Width of the sidebar. Default 240. |
| rightPanelWidth | string \| number | No | 320 | Width of the right panel. Default 320. |
| sidebarCollapsible | boolean | No | — | When true, exposes a collapse toggle to hide the sidebar. |
| sidebarDefaultCollapsed | boolean | No | — | Initial collapsed state for the sidebar. |
| sidebarCollapsed | boolean | No | — | Controlled sidebar collapsed state. |
| onSidebarCollapsedChange | ((collapsed: boolean) => void) | No | — |  |
| sidebarResizable | boolean | No | — | When true, adds a drag handle on the sidebar's trailing edge so users can resize it. The width is reported via `onSidebarWidthChange` and stays within `sidebarMinWidth`/`sidebarMaxWidth`. |
| sidebarMinWidth | number | No | 180 | Minimum width when resizing (px). Default 180. |
| sidebarMaxWidth | number | No | 480 | Maximum width when resizing (px). Default 480. |
| onSidebarWidthChange | ((width: number) => void) | No | — | Fires on each resize with the new width (px). |
| headerHeight | string \| number | No | — | Height of the header in pixels/CSS value. Default "auto". |
| mobileBreakpoint | number | No | 768 | Viewport width at which the sidebar becomes a mobile overlay drawer. Default 768. |

#### Masonry

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |

| collapsed | boolean | No | false | When true, collapses labels so only icons remain (rail mode). |

#### ContextMenu
Source: `src/components/Menu.tsx`

Right-click / long-press context menu. Subparts mirror `Menu`; position follows the pointer.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| content | ReactNode | Yes | — | Menu content rendered when the user right-clicks or long-presses the trigger children. ContextMenu wraps this slot in an internal `<Menu>` provider, so the `Menu.*` compound subcomponents (`Menu.Item`, `Menu.CheckboxItem`, `Menu.RadioItem`, `Menu.Separator`, `Menu.Label`, `Menu.Sub` / `Menu.SubTrigger` / `Menu.SubContent`) all work directly inside `content` without needing a manual `<Menu>` wrapper. Plain elements (`<div>`, custom buttons, etc.) also work. Equivalent compound subcomponents are also re-exported as `ContextMenu.Item` / `ContextMenu.CheckboxItem` / `ContextMenu.Separator` etc. for ergonomics — pick whichever shape reads better at the call site. |

#### Wizard
Source: `src/components/Wizard.tsx`

Multi-step form/workflow container. Compose `Wizard.Step` (one per step) and drive navigation with `Wizard.Previous` / `Wizard.Next` inside `Wizard.Footer`; `Wizard.StepIndicator` shows "Step X of N". Controlled via `value` (step id) + `onValueChange`, or uncontrolled via `defaultValue`. Per-step validation via `canAdvance(id)`; `onComplete` fires from the last step.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| value | string | No | — | Controlled current step id. |
| defaultValue | string | No | — | Uncontrolled default step id. Falls back to the first step. |
| onValueChange | ((stepId: string) => void) | No | — |  |
| onComplete | (() => void) | No | — | Called when the final step completes. |

| showStepper | boolean | No | true | Show a built-in step indicator above the content. Default true. |

#### NumberInput
Source: `src/components/FormExtended.tsx`

Numeric text input with min/max/step, keyboard increment/decrement, and locale parsing. Accessibility / test ergonomics: rest-spread props (including `data-testid` and `aria-*`) are forwarded to the inner native `<input type="number">` so `getByTestId(id)` returns the actual control and `.value` reads work. Use `wrapperProps` for attributes that genuinely belong on the outer div.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| value | NumberInputValue | No | — |  |
| defaultValue | NumberInputValue | No | — |  |

| min | number | No | 0 |  |
| max | number | No | 100 |  |
| step | number | No | 1 |  |

| width | string \| number | No | — |  |
| size | enum | No | md | Voidframe-native size variant. Mirrors Input/Textarea/Select so forms read consistently at any density. Applied to the inner `<input>` via the `.vf-input--{size}` class pattern. |
| defaultBlank | boolean | No | — | When true, the uncontrolled default is `""` (empty) instead of `min ?? 0`. Use for forms where "no entry yet" should remain distinguishable from `0` until the user types. |
| wrapperProps | HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> | No | — | Props to apply to the outer wrapper `<div>`. Use this when a consumer needs to attach a `data-*` attribute or ref to the container rather than the inner numeric `<input>`. Rest-spread (`{...props}`) lands on the native `<input>` element so `data-testid`, `aria-*`, and any other HTMLAttributes are forwarded to the control as consumers expect. |

#### Slider
Source: `src/components/FormExtended.tsx`

Range slider for numeric values. Controllable via `value` / `onValueChange`; supports one or two thumbs. When `range` is true, `value` / `defaultValue` accept `[min, max]` tuples and two thumbs are rendered. The fill spans between the two thumbs and thumbs are constrained so they cannot cross each other. Accessibility / test ergonomics: rest-spread props (including `data-testid` and `aria-*`) are forwarded to the inner native `<input type="range">` so `getByTestId(id)` returns the actual control and `.value` reads work. Use `wrapperProps` for attributes that genuinely belong on the outer div.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| value | number \| [number, number] | No | — | Single value or `[min, max]` pair when `range` is true. |
| defaultValue | number \| [number, number] | No | — | Default single value or `[min, max]` pair when `range` is true. |
| onValueChange | ((value: number \| [number, number]) => void) | No | — | Emits a single number or `[min, max]` pair depending on `range`. |
| min | number | No | 0 |  |
| max | number | No | 100 |  |
| step | number | No | 1 |  |
| label | string | No | — |  |
| accent | string | No | — |  |
| showValue | boolean | No | — |  |
| range | boolean | No | — | When true, render two thumbs for selecting a numeric range. `value` and `onValueChange` operate on `[min, max]` tuples. Thumbs are constrained so the min thumb cannot exceed the max thumb and vice versa. |
| wrapperProps | HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> | No | — | Attributes for the outer wrapper `<div>`. Use for container-level `data-*` hooks. Rest-spread (`{...props}`) lands on the inner native `<input type="range">` so `data-testid`/`aria-*` forward to the control. |

### Data

#### AsyncData
Source: `src/components/AsyncData.tsx`

Universal async-data envelope. Eliminates per-component `loading ? <Skeleton /> : data ? <Table /> : <Empty />` boilerplate by routing to the correct slot based on `status`.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| status | enum | Yes | — | The current state. Determines which slot renders. |
| data | T | No | — | The data, available when `status === "success"`. |
| error | unknown | No | — | Error payload, available when `status === "error"`. |
| loading | ReactNode | No | — | Render while loading. Defaults to a minimal skeleton. |
| empty | ReactNode | No | — | Render when the dataset is empty. |
| renderError | ((error: unknown, retry?: (() => void)) => ReactNode) | No | — | Render when loading failed. Receives the error + a retry handle. |
| onRetry | (() => void) | No | — | Callback wired into the default error UI's retry button. |

#### Avatar
Source: `src/components/DataExtended.tsx`

Circular or rounded image for a person or entity with initial / icon fallback. Sizes (`xs`-`xl`), tones, and `loading="lazy" | "eager"` pass through to the underlying `<img>`.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|

| status | enum | No | — |  |
| square | boolean | No | — | Render a square (non-rounded) avatar. |

#### CodeBlock
Source: `src/components/Viewers/CodeBlock.tsx`

Fenced code block with optional language-aware syntax highlighting, copy button, and line numbers.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| code | string | Yes | — |  |
| language | string | No | — |  |
| theme | string | No | — |  |
| lineNumbers | boolean | No | true |  |
| highlightLines | number[] | No | — |  |
| copyable | boolean | No | — |  |
| fileName | ReactNode | No | — |  |
| maxHeight | string \| number | No | — |  |
| highlight | ((code: string, language?: string) => ReactNode) | No | — | Optional highlight function. Must return safe HTML (escapes its input) OR ReactNode. When given a string, the CodeBlock writes through the HTMLPane; callers are expected to sanitize. |
| searchable | boolean | No | false | Show a search bar above the code. Default false. |
| downloadable | boolean | No | false | Show a download button. Default false. |
| downloadFilename | string | No | code.txt | Filename for download. Defaults to "code.txt". |
| lineAnnotations | Record<number, ReactNode> | No | — | Inline annotations attached to specific lines. Each entry pins a `ReactNode` (typically an error message, lint note, or doc snippet) directly below the matched 1-based line number. When `highlight` / pre-rendered HTML is in use the annotations render after the matched line by adding a sibling annotation block with the line-specific content. |

#### DataList
Source: `src/components/DataList.tsx`

Read-only list of label/value rows for summaries and key/value UIs. Dual API: pass an `items` array, or compose `DataList.Item` children. `orientation="horizontal"` (default) renders a two-column grid; `"vertical"` stacks label above value.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| items | DataListItem[] | No | — |  |
| orientation | enum | No | horizontal | Orientation. Default "horizontal" (2-col). |
| itemAttributes | ((item: DataListItem, index: number) => HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>) | No | — | Return arbitrary HTML attributes to apply to each rendered row when the array-API (`items`) is used. Tests / instrumentation can attach `data-testid` / `aria-*` per row without falling back to content-based queries. The compound API (`<DataList.Item>`) already accepts spread props directly. |

#### EmptyState
Source: `src/components/DataExtended.tsx`

Centred illustration + title + description + optional action. Use when a list/table/view has no data yet. When neither `icon` nor `action` is supplied, the `"decorated"` variant renders a default inbox glyph and a bordered tile so the no-props case doesn't feel bare. Opt into `variant="plain"` for pre-styled containers.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| icon | ReactNode | No | — |  |
| title | string | No | — |  |
| description | string | No | — |  |
| action | ReactNode | No | — |  |
| variant | enum | No | decorated | Visual variant. - `"decorated"` (default) — renders a default inbox glyph + framed tile when no explicit icon / action is supplied, so the no-props case still reads as intentional empty-UI instead of centred naked text. - `"plain"` — skips the default icon + tile; just centres whatever props are passed. Use inside pre-styled containers. |

#### Table
Source: `src/components/Data.tsx`

Identity helper that anchors `T` at the column-declaration site, avoiding TypeScript inference collapsing to a looser type when columns are defined inline alongside the data. Usage: type Row = { id: string; name: string; count: number }; const columns = defineColumns<Row>([ { key: "name", header: "Name" }, { key: "count", header: "Count", render: (r) => r.count.toFixed(0) }, ]);

| loadChildren | ((node: TreeNode) => Promise<TreeNode[]>) | No | — |  |
| itemAttributes | ((node: TreeNode, depth: number) => HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>) | No | — | Return arbitrary HTML attributes for each rendered tree node. Mirrors `Table.rowAttributes` — tests can attach `data-testid` per node without injecting marker spans inside `renderItem`. |

#### VirtualList
Source: `src/components/Virtualization.tsx`

Virtualized list. Memoized via `genericMemo` so the per-item-type generic survives. Parent re-renders with stable `items` / `renderItem` skip the slice computation + visible-window render.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| items | T[] | Yes | — |  |
| itemHeight | number \| ((index: number, item: T) => number) | Yes | — |  |
| estimatedItemHeight | number | No | — | Hint for the average rendered size when `itemHeight` is a function. Unmeasured rows use this value for offset/viewport math on first paint; real measurements (via ResizeObserver on rendered rows) progressively replace estimates. Ignored when `itemHeight` is a number. Without this hint, variable-height lists fall back to calling `itemHeight(index, item)` for every item on mount — fine for hundreds of rows, not thousands. |
| overscan | number | No | — | Rows to render beyond the visible window. |
| horizontal | boolean | No | — |  |
| renderItem | (item: T, index: number, style: CSSProperties) => ReactNode | Yes | — |  |
| onEndReached | (() => void) | No | — |  |
| endThreshold | number | No | — | Threshold (0..1) of the viewport before onEndReached fires. |

#### CommentList
Source: `src/components/Comment.tsx`

Threaded comment list with optional load-more affordance. **Threaded mode:** pass `comments` (flat array with `parentId` references) and `renderComment` to build a nested tree automatically. Replies indent up to `maxDepth` levels and auto-collapse beyond `defaultCollapsedDepth`. **Simple mode (deprecated):** pass `Comment` components as `children` for a flat, non-threaded list. This form is backwards-compatible but will not receive new threading features.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| comments | CommentData[] | No | — | Flat array of comments with parentId references for threading. |
| renderComment | ((comment: CommentData, depth: number) => ReactNode) | No | — | Render function for each comment. Receives the comment data and its depth level. |
| maxDepth | number | No | 5 | Maximum nesting depth. Default 5. |
| defaultCollapsedDepth | number | No | — | Auto-collapse replies beyond this depth. Default Infinity (no auto-collapse). |
| onLoadMore | (() => void) | No | — | Called when user clicks "Load more". |
| hasMore | boolean | No | — | Show load-more button. |
| loading | boolean | No | — | Show loading spinner in load-more area. |

#### Tooltip
Source: `src/components/Popovers.tsx`

Compact labelling overlay. Wraps a single child and shows `content` on hover or focus with a configurable `openDelay` / `closeDelay`. Wires `aria-describedby` by default, or `aria-label` when `asAriaLabel` is set and `content` is a string. Inherits shared timing from a surrounding `TooltipProvider`.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| content | ReactNode | Yes | — |  |
| placement | enum | No | bottom |  |
| offset | number | No | 8 |  |
| openDelay | number | No | — |  |
| closeDelay | number | No | 100 |  |
| asAriaLabel | boolean | No | — | Override aria pattern. Default infers from focusability. |

#### TooltipContent
Source: `src/components/Popovers.tsx`

Body rendered inside the tooltip popup. Registers into `Tooltip.Root`.

#### TooltipProvider
Source: `src/components/Popovers.tsx`

Groups `Tooltip` instances to share timing. Once one tooltip closes, hovering another within `skipDelayDuration` (ms) opens instantly instead of re-incurring `delayDuration`. Place near the root of the app (or a sub-tree of related controls).

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| delayDuration | number | No | 300 |  |
| skipDelayDuration | number | No | 200 |  |

#### TooltipRoot
Source: `src/components/Popovers.tsx`

Compound root that collects Trigger and Content slots for a Tooltip instance.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| placement | enum | No | bottom |  |
| offset | number | No | 8 |  |
| openDelay | number | No | — |  |
| closeDelay | number | No | — |  |
| asAriaLabel | boolean | No | — |  |

#### TooltipTrigger
Source: `src/components/Popovers.tsx`

Element that shows the tooltip on hover/focus. Registers into `Tooltip.Root`.

#### SlideIn
Source: `src/components/Animations.tsx`

Slides (and fades) children in from a given direction when they scroll into view. Respects `prefers-reduced-motion` (renders immediately).

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| direction | enum | No | up | Direction to slide from. Default "up". |
| distance | string \| number | No | 20px | Distance to travel. Default "20px". |
| duration | number | No | 300 | Animation duration in ms. Default 300. |
| delay | number | No | 0 | Delay before animation starts in ms. Default 0. |
| easing | string | No | ease | CSS easing function. Default "ease". |
| triggerOnce | boolean | No | true | Only animate the first time the element enters the viewport. Default true. |

#### Ticker
Source: `src/components/Animations.tsx`

Numeric counter/odometer that animates between two values. Supports smooth easing or discrete stepped transitions. Respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| from | number | No | 0 |  |
| to | number | Yes | — |  |
| duration | number | No | 300 | Animation duration in ms. Default 800. |
| format | ((n: number) => string) | No | (n) => Math.round(n).toLocaleString() |  |
| steps | number | No | — | Emit exactly N evenly-spaced discrete values between `from` and `to` instead of smoothly interpolating. Useful when the ticker should hit specific round numbers. When 0 or unset, the smooth easing path runs. |

#### Typewriter
Source: `src/components/Animations.tsx`

Types out a string character by character. Respects `prefers-reduced-motion` (renders immediately).

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| text | string | Yes | — |  |
| speed | number | No | 20 | Typing speed in characters per second. Default 20. |
| cursor | boolean | No | true |  |
| loop | boolean | No | true | Loop the animation by clearing + retyping. |
| loopDelay | number | No | 1500 | Pause at end before looping (ms). |
| onComplete | (() => void) | No | — | Fires every time the full string finishes typing. When `loop` is true this fires per cycle (once before each clear + retype), not just the first completion. Callers that only want the first completion should gate inside the handler (e.g. a `useRef` sentinel). |

#### Brush
Source: `src/charts/primitives/Brush.tsx`

Chart brush primitive: a draggable window that scopes the visible domain. Emits `onChange(range)` for coordinating focus+context charts.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| value | BrushSelection | No | — | Controlled selection. |
| defaultValue | BrushSelection | No | null | Default (uncontrolled) selection. |
| onValueChange | ((selection: BrushSelection) => void) | No | — | Fires while dragging and on release. |
| onChangeEnd | ((selection: BrushSelection) => void) | No | — | Fires only when the user releases the pointer. |
| minWidth | number | No | 6 | Minimum width of the selection, in px. Default 6. When the user's drag-end selection is narrower than `minWidth`, the selection is cleared (emits `null`) rather than snapping to the minimum. |
| axis | enum | No | x | Restrict to the X axis (default) or Y axis. |

#### ChartScales
Source: `src/charts/primitives/ChartContext.tsx`

Re-publishes ChartContext with the provided scales merged in. Inner-chart components (AreaChartInner, BarChartInner, etc.) wrap their rendered SVG tree in `<ChartScales xScale={xScale} yScale={yScale}>` so descendants like `<Gridlines>`, `<ReferenceLine>`, and `<ReferenceBand>` — which read scales from context — actually see the computed values. Without this, scales are computed inside the inner component (they depend on `innerWidth` / `innerHeight` from the context), but never propagated back through a provider, leaving sibling primitives with undefined scales.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| xScale | AxisTickScale | No | — |  |
| yScale | AxisTickScale | No | — |  |

ChevronDown icon. Decorative by default; supply `label` to promote to `role="img"`. Monoline, 1px stroke, 24x24 at `size="md"`.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| size | number \| IconSize | No | — |  |
| color | string | No | — |  |
| strokeWidth | number | No | — |  |
| label | string | No | — | Accessible name. If omitted, icon is marked decorative (aria-hidden). |
| decorative | boolean | No | — | Force decorative (aria-hidden) even when label is provided. |
| directional | boolean | No | — | Marks this icon as direction-sensitive. CSS mirrors it automatically under `[dir="rtl"]`. |
| flipX | boolean | No | — |  |
| flipY | boolean | No | — |  |
| rotate | enum | No | — |  |
| spin | boolean | No | — | Continuous rotation. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion. |
| pulse | boolean | No | — | Opacity pulse. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion. |

#### Icon
Source: `src/icons/Icon.tsx`

Generic SVG icon wrapper. Takes a named glyph or arbitrary children, normalises `size` and `color` tokens, and forwards to a `role="img"` / `aria-label`ed `<svg>` when `label` is present (decorative otherwise). Memoized — icons render frequently inside rows/lists.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| color | string | No | — |  |
| rotate | enum | No | — |  |
| strokeWidth | number | No | 1 |  |
| size | number \| IconSize | No | md |  |
| label | string | No | — | Accessible name. If omitted, icon is marked decorative (aria-hidden). |
| decorative | boolean | No | — | Force decorative (aria-hidden) even when label is provided. |
| directional | boolean | No | — | Marks this icon as direction-sensitive. CSS mirrors it automatically under `[dir="rtl"]`. |
| flipX | boolean | No | — |  |
| flipY | boolean | No | — |  |
| spin | boolean | No | — | Continuous rotation. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion. |
| pulse | boolean | No | — | Opacity pulse. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion. |

#### IconButton
Source: `src/icons/IconButton.tsx`

Icon-only button. Requires `aria-label` (or `aria-labelledby`) so screen readers announce the action; dev warns without one.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| variant | enum | No | outline |  |
| size | enum | No | md |  |
| accent | string | No | — |  |
| tone | enum | No | — | Semantic tone. Mirrors Button/Badge/AlertV2. Sets `data-tone` + a `vf-icon-button--tone-…` modifier, and primes `--vf-accent` to the matching token when no explicit `accent` is passed. |
| tooltip | ReactNode | No | — | Short text shown on hover / focus above the button. |
| active | boolean | No | — | Toggle state. |

#### IconGroup
Source: `src/icons/IconButton.tsx`

Compact group of icons displayed inline (e.g. status badges). Optional overflow chip.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| gap | number | No | 4 |  |
| align | enum | No | center |  |
| separator | ReactNode | No | — |  |

### Chat & AI

#### AgentRunner
Source: `src/components/ChatModel.tsx`

Orchestrates a live agent run: streams reasoning steps, tool calls, and output into a scrollable trace. Feed `steps` (or an async iterable via `onStep`) and it renders the history plus current status.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| conversation | ReactNode | Yes | — |  |
| plan | ReactNode | No | — |  |
| trace | ReactNode | No | — |  |
| header | ReactNode | No | — |  |

#### AgentStep
Source: `src/components/ChatAgent.tsx`

Single step in an agent trace: a numbered card with title, status pill, optional tool calls, output, and elapsed time. Controllable/uncontrolled via `expanded` / `defaultExpanded` / `onExpandedChange`. Responds to `AgentTraceContext.expandAll` for bulk expand/collapse.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| number | ReactNode | No | — |  |
| title | ReactNode | Yes | — |  |
| status | enum | No | complete |  |
| toolCalls | ReactNode | No | — |  |
| output | ReactNode | No | — |  |
| duration | number | No | — |  |
| defaultExpanded | boolean | No | false |  |
| expanded | boolean | No | — |  |
| onExpandedChange | ((next: boolean) => void) | No | — |  |

#### AgentTrace
Source: `src/components/ChatAgent.tsx`

Full trace view for an agent run — wraps a list of `AgentStep`s with status summary and expand-all controls. Provides `AgentTraceContext` so child `AgentStep`s can respond to bulk expand/collapse.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| steps | ReactNode | No | — |  |
| tokens | AgentTraceTokens | No | — |  |
| cost | ReactNode | No | — |  |
| duration | number | No | — |  |
| status | enum | No | complete |  |
| onStop | (() => void) | No | — | Called when the user clicks the stop button during a running/streaming agent. |

#### Attachment
Source: `src/components/ChatAttachments.tsx`

Single attachment chip: icon, filename, size, optional preview / download affordances. Used inside `AttachmentList` and the composer.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| kind | enum | No | file |  |
| name | ReactNode | No | — |  |
| size | ReactNode | No | — |  |
| thumbnail | ReactNode | No | — |  |
| icon | ReactNode | No | — |  |
| onOpen | (() => void) | No | — |  |
| onDownload | (() => void) | No | — |  |
| onRemove | (() => void) | No | — |  |
| readOnly | boolean | No | — | When true, hides the default action buttons (for read-only displays). |

| orientation | enum | No | horizontal |  |

#### Composer
Source: `src/components/ChatComposer.tsx`

Chat message composer with text area, attachment tray, mic button, and send. Compound subparts (`Composer.Input`, `Composer.Attachments`, `Composer.Actions`).

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|

| onSubmit | ((value: string) => void) | No | — |  |
| onStop | (() => void) | No | — |  |
| onSlashCommand | ((command: string) => void) | No | — |  |
| status | enum | No | idle | Visual + behavior status. `"streaming"` indicates the assistant is generating a response. By default voidframe now disables the composer input while `status="streaming"` (matching the common chat-UI expectation: no typing during generation, use `onStop`). Pass explicit `disabled={false}` to override when you deliberately want interruption via typing. |
| disabled | boolean | No | — |  |
| submitOnEnter | boolean | No | — |  |
| shiftEnterNewline | boolean | No | — |  |
| maxLength | number | No | — |  |
| showCount | boolean | No | — |  |

#### ComposerMicButton

| recording | boolean | No | — | When true, treat as controlled recording state. |
| defaultRecording | boolean | No | false |  |
| onRecordingChange | ((next: boolean) => void) | No | — |  |

#### ContextWindow
Source: `src/components/ChatModel.tsx`

Visualises an LLM context window: used vs available tokens as a meter plus breakdown by section.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| used | number | Yes | — |  |
| max | number | No | 99 |  |
| label | ReactNode | No | Unread |  |
| kind | enum | No | default | Layout variant. `"default"` renders the full header (label + counts) and progress bar. `"compact"` renders a count-only pill matching `ChatTokenCounter`'s compact form — suited for `ConversationHeader` action slots where a progress bar would feel heavy. |

#### LatencyIndicator
Source: `src/components/ChatModel.tsx`

Colour-coded indicator for a latency reading (ms). Thresholds configurable.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| value | number | Yes | — | Latency in ms. |
| label | ReactNode | No | Unread |  |
| kind | enum | No | default | Layout variant. `"default"` renders label + value; `"compact"` shows only the value pill — matches the compact vocabulary of the other chat telemetry widgets (`ContextWindow`, `ChatTokenCounter`, `CostDisplay`). |
| goodThreshold | number | No | 500 | Upper bound (ms) for "good" tone. Default 500. |
| warnThreshold | number | No | 2000 | Upper bound (ms) for "warn" tone. Default 2000. |
| slowThreshold | number | No | 5000 | Upper bound (ms) for "slow" tone. Default 5000. |

#### MessageActions
Source: `src/components/Chat/Actions.tsx`

Action rail for a chat message (copy / edit / regenerate / react). Visible on hover, keyboard-accessible.

#### MessageContent
Source: `src/components/Chat/Message.tsx`

Body slot of a chat `Message` — renders markdown, attachments, code blocks, and citations. Also accepts arbitrary `children` for streaming + tool-call composition. `MessageMarkdown` is a named alias for consumers who prefer explicit naming for the content-rendering role.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| content | string \| MessagePart[] | No | — | Renderable message data — a plain string (with optional `markdown`), or a structured `MessagePart[]` that renders markdown/code/attachments/ citations. Optional when `children` is supplied. |
| markdown | boolean | No | — |  |
| streaming | boolean | No | — |  |
| cursor | boolean | No | true |  |
| citations | ReactNode | No | — |  |

#### MessageList
Source: `src/components/Chat/Conversation.tsx`

Virtualised scrollable list of `Message`s. Handles auto-scroll-to-bottom and a "new messages" affordance. Pinned-state resolution: when nested inside a `<Conversation>` context, the shared `pinnedToBottom` flag wins — multiple `MessageList`s can share a single pin-state across the conversation. When rendered standalone, the list falls back to its own local pinned state tied to its own scroll container.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| autoScroll | boolean | No | true | If true (default), scrolls to bottom on new children while pinned. |
| pinThreshold | number | No | — | Pixels from bottom that still count as "pinned". |

#### SimpleChat
Source: `src/components/ChatModel.tsx`

Prewired minimal chat UI: conversation + composer + model selector. Fastest path to a working chat surface. When `onSend` is provided a `Composer` with input and submit button renders below the conversation. When `models` + `onModelChange` are provided a `ModelSelector` is rendered in the header.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| conversation | ReactNode | Yes | — |  |
| header | ReactNode | No | — |  |
| onSend | ((message: string) => void) | No | — | When provided, renders a `Composer` below the conversation area. |
| onModelChange | ((model: string) => void) | No | — | When provided alongside `models`, renders a `ModelSelector` in the header. |
| models | { value: string; label: string; }[] | No | — | Model options for the header model selector. |

### Specialty

#### Barcode
Source: `src/components/Encoding.tsx`

Renders a scannable 1D barcode from a value. Requires the optional peer dependency `jsbarcode` to produce real output. When the peer is missing OR still loading, the component renders a clearly-labelled placeholder pattern. Bypass both by passing a pre-computed `pattern` prop (1 = bar, 0 = gap).

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| value | string | Yes | — |  |
| format | enum | No | code128 |  |
| height | number | No | 56 | Height in px. |
| barWidth | number | No | 2 | Pixel width per "unit" bar. Default 2. |
| pattern | number[] | No | — | Pre-computed binary bar pattern (1 = bar, 0 = gap). Bypasses both the peer-dep encoder and the placeholder. Takes precedence when set. |
| showText | boolean | No | true |  |

#### BigNumber
Source: `src/components/Numeric.tsx`

Large hero metric: value, optional delta/trend, and caption. Use inside dashboards; pair with `Sparkline` for an inline trend.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| value | ReactNode | Yes | — |  |
| unit | ReactNode | No | — |  |
| label | ReactNode | No | — |  |
| delta | ReactNode | No | — |  |

| align | enum | No | start |  |
| size | enum | No | lg |  |

#### DashboardGrid
Source: `src/components/Widget.tsx`

Sub-cell coordinate dashboard grid with drag-to-move and drag-to-resize. Uses BFS collision avoidance to prevent card overlap. Cards snap to a configurable cell grid (`cols` × `cellSize`). Supports swap-on-drop and live preview during drag.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| items | DashboardLayoutItem[] | Yes | — |  |
| onLayoutChange | ((next: DashboardLayoutItem[]) => void) | No | — |  |
| cols | number | No | 24 | Total sub-cell columns across the canvas. Default 24. |
| cellSize | number | No | 32 | Pixel size of one sub-cell side. Default 32. |
| gap | number | No | 4 | Pixel gap between sub-cells. Default 4. |
| renderItem | (id: string, item: DashboardLayoutItem) => ReactNode | Yes | — | Render function per item. |
| movable | boolean | No | true | Allow click-drag to move cards. Default true. |
| resizable | boolean | No | false | Show corner-resize grips on each card. Default false. |
| minW | number | No | 2 | Min sub-cell width when resizing. Default 2. |
| minH | number | No | 2 | Min sub-cell height when resizing. Default 2. |
| maxW | number | No | — | Max sub-cell width. Default `cols`. |
| maxH | number | No | — | Max sub-cell height. Defaults to bounds rows or unbounded. |
| bounds | DashboardBounds | No | auto | `"auto"` (default) grows the canvas in both axes to fit the furthest card; pass `{ rows: N }` for a fixed sub-cell row count (horizontal still grows past `cols` if a card requires it). |
| autoPaddingRows | number | No | 4 | Empty rows below the lowest card when growing vertically. Default 4. |
| autoPaddingCols | number | No | 4 | Empty columns to the right of the furthest card when growing horizontally. Default 4. |
| collisionSearchCap | number | No | 4000 | Upper bound on the number of candidate cells the collision-avoidance search will evaluate before bailing out. Default 4000 — enough for grids up to ~60×60 sub-cells. Raise this if you have a very dense, large canvas and are seeing drop targets snap to arbitrary positions; lower it to cap worst-case CPU on pathological layouts. |

#### DebugTree
Source: `src/components/DevTools.tsx`

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |

| data | unknown | Yes | — |  |
| format | enum | No | json | Serialization format. Default `"json"` (uses the collapsible viewer). |
| defaultExpanded | number \| boolean | No | 2 | Depth to expand initially. Default 1. `true` expands all. Ignored for YAML. |
| rootLabel | ReactNode | No | — |  |

#### PercentDisplay
Source: `src/components/Numeric.tsx`

Locale-aware percentage formatter. Defaults to treating `value` as already-in-percent (50 → "50%"); switch with `basis="fraction"` when your source is a 0-1 ratio.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| value | number | Yes | — | Value to render. By default interpreted as already in percent units (`value={50}` → `"50%"`). Pass `basis="fraction"` if your value is a 0-1 ratio (`value={0.5}` + `basis="fraction"` → `"50%"`). |
| basis | enum | No | percent | `"percent"` (default): value is 0-100. `"fraction"`: value is 0-1. |
| decimals | number | No | 1 |  |
| locale | string | No | — |  |
| signed | boolean | No | — |  |
| autoTone | boolean | No | — |  |

#### PrintButton
Source: `src/components/Print.tsx`

Button that invokes `window.print()` with optional before/after hooks for transient styling. Caveat: when a `target` ref is provided, the subtree is serialized via `outerHTML` into a hidden iframe. Serialization is lossy — canvas bitmaps, hydrated event listeners, shadow DOM contents, and `<input>` values not reflected in attributes will not round-trip. For pixel-perfect prints of dynamic content, take a screenshot via `html2canvas` (or similar) first.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| target | RefObject<HTMLElement> | No | — |  |
| documentTitle | string | No | — |  |

#### PrintLayout

| subtitle | ReactNode | No | — |  |
| includeHeader | boolean | No | true |  |
| includeFooter | boolean | No | false |  |
| footer | ReactNode | No | — |  |
| pageBreakInside | enum | No | avoid |  |

#### QRCode
Source: `src/components/Encoding.tsx`

Renders a scannable QR code SVG from a string. Requires the optional peer dependency `qrcode-generator` to produce real output. When the peer is missing OR still loading, the component renders a clearly-labelled placeholder. Bypass both by passing a pre-computed `matrix` prop.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| value | string | Yes | — |  |
| size | number | No | 160 |  |
| ecc | enum | No | L |  |
| matrix | boolean[][] | No | — | Provide a pre-computed NxN boolean matrix to bypass both the peer-dep encoder and the placeholder. Takes precedence when set. |
| logo | ReactNode | No | — | Optional logo overlay (rendered centered, 20% size). |

#### ShortcutGuide
Source: `src/components/ShortcutGuide.tsx`

Overlay that lists all registered keyboard shortcuts grouped by scope. Populated via `ShortcutProvider`. Non-modal by design: the guide is intended as an on-demand reference (press `?` → peek → dismiss) rather than a task-blocking dialog, so it does not portal, trap focus, or scroll-lock the page. If you need a modal cheat-sheet, wrap it in a `<Dialog>` instead.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| triggerKeys | string | No | ? | Key combo that toggles the guide. Default "?". |
| alwaysVisible | boolean | No | — | When true, the guide is always visible (useful for docs). |
| open | boolean | No | — | Controlled open state. |
| onOpenChange | ((open: boolean) => void) | No | — |  |
| title | string | No | Keyboard shortcuts |  |
| noAutoBind | boolean | No | — | Don't bind the trigger key globally. |

| fields | enum | No | — | Number of fields in the cron expression. 5 = standard UNIX (minute / hour / day / month / weekday); 6 = Quartz-style with a leading seconds field. Defaults to the width of the current `value` / `defaultValue`, falling back to 5. |

#### ThemeScope
Source: `src/provider/ThemeScope.tsx`

Subtree-level theme override. Wrap any subtree to apply a different theme without rerooting the whole app.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| theme | VoidframeTokens \| Partial<VoidframeTokens> | No | — |  |
| themeName | "dark" \| "light" \| "midnight" \| "grey" \| (string & {}) | No | — |  |
| density | enum | No | — |  |
| contrast | enum | No | — |  |
| direction | enum | No | — |  |
| reducedMotion | enum | No | — |  |
| inline | boolean | No | — | Render as a span to avoid creating a block-level wrapper. |
| globalize | boolean | No | — | When true, theme attributes are also mirrored to `document.documentElement` for the lifetime of this scope. Use inside a portaled overlay when you need nested theming to affect the whole page (rare). Defaults to `false` — nested scopes are local-only. |

#### VoidframeProvider
Source: `src/provider/VoidframeProvider.tsx`

Theme provider. Wraps your app (or a subtree) and injects: - `.vf-root` baseline class - `data-vf-theme` for stylesheet-driven theme switching - `data-vf-density`, `data-vf-contrast`, `data-vf-motion` for modes - `dir` for RTL - CSS custom properties on `style` when `theme` supplies runtime overrides

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| theme | VoidframeTokens \| Partial<VoidframeTokens> | No | — | Full token set or partial overrides merged over `defaultTokens`. For pure theme switching, prefer `themeName`. |
| themeName | ThemeName | No | dark | Named theme. `"system"` follows `prefers-color-scheme`. Custom strings are emitted as `data-vf-theme="…"` so consumer CSS can register new palettes statically. |
| density | enum | No | comfortable | Density mode. Scales spacing globally. |
| contrast | enum | No | normal | Contrast mode. Boosts text + border tokens under `"high"`. |
| direction | enum | No | — | Writing direction. Root gains `dir="…"`. |
| reducedMotion | enum | No | auto | Motion behavior. `"auto"` (default) respects OS preference; `"always"` force-disables motion; `"never"` overrides the OS preference and keeps animations on. |
| cssBaseline | boolean | No | false | Inject the optional CSS reset (`.vf-baseline`). |
| locale | LocalePack | No | — | Full locale pack (messages + direction + firstDayOfWeek). When supplied, direction auto-derives from the pack unless the `direction` prop above overrides it. |
| messages | PartialMessages | No | — | Partial message overrides layered on top of `locale` (or English). |
| localeTag | string | No | — | Override the BCP-47 locale tag independent of the locale pack. |
| firstDayOfWeek | number | No | — | 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. Derived from locale pack when omitted. |
| timeZone | string | No | — | Default time zone for date/time rendering. |
| scope | enum | No | global | Where theme attributes get written. Default `"global"` writes to `document.documentElement` so portaled overlays inherit the theme. Pass `"root"` to restrict theme scoping to the provider's wrapper div. |

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| source | ReactNode | No | — | The file/source identifier shown in the header. Optional — omit when the surrounding UI already says where the error is. |

| after | string[] | No | — | Lines rendered dimmed AFTER the error line. |
| message | ReactNode | No | — | The error / warning message itself. |
| tone | enum | No | danger | Tone — default `"danger"`. Mirrors AlertV2/Badge tones. |
| compact | boolean | No | — | When true, renders a compact one-line variant (just message + line ref). |

## Hooks

#### ShortcutProvider
Source: `src/hooks/useShortcuts.tsx`
```ts
export function ShortcutProvider({ children }: ShortcutProviderProps)
```
Provider that registers the global shortcut registry. Wrap your app root; `useShortcut` / `useShortcutRegistry` read from it.

#### useAbortController
Source: `src/hooks/useAbortController.ts`
```ts
export function useAbortController(): UseAbortControllerReturn
```
Manage an `AbortController` tied to a component's lifecycle. The controller is automatically aborted on unmount. Use `reset()` to replace the current controller (aborting the previous one) and `abort()` to cancel the current one in place.

#### useAnnouncer
Source: `src/hooks/useAnnouncer.ts`
```ts
export function useAnnouncer(): AnnouncerApi
```
Announce dynamic messages to assistive tech via a shared `aria-live` region. Creates two hidden regions (polite + assertive) once per page and reuses them.

#### useAsync
Source: `src/hooks/useAsync.ts`
```ts
export function useAsync<T, A extends unknown[] = []>( fn: (...args: A) => Promise<T> ): UseAsyncReturn<T, A>
```
Manage an async function's lifecycle — pending / success / error. `run()` returns the resolved value (or undefined if cancelled by unmount). Stale results are discarded after unmount.

#### useAsyncCallback
Source: `src/hooks/useAsyncCallback.ts`
```ts
export function useAsyncCallback<T, A extends unknown[] = []>( fn: (...args: A) => Promise<T> ): UseAsyncReturn<T, A>
```
Alias of `useAsync` — use whichever name reads better at the call site.

#### useClickOutside
Source: `src/hooks/index.ts`
```ts
export function useClickOutside<T extends HTMLElement = HTMLElement>( onClickOutside: () => void ): RefObject<T>
```
Detect clicks outside a ref'd element. @returns A ref to attach to the element whose outside-clicks you want to detect.

#### useClipboardRead
Source: `src/hooks/useClipboardRead.ts`
```ts
export function useClipboardRead(): UseClipboardReadReturn
```
Read from the clipboard. Manages loading/error state.

#### useColorScheme
Source: `src/hooks/useColorScheme.ts`
```ts
export function useColorScheme( initial: ColorScheme = "system" ): UseColorSchemeReturn
```
Manage color-scheme with "system" auto-resolution. Does not persist — pair with `useLocalStorage` for that.

#### useControllableState
Source: `src/hooks/useControllableState.ts`
```ts
export function useControllableState<T>(
```
Controlled-or-uncontrolled state primitive. - When `value` is provided, the component is controlled — internal state is ignored, and `onChange` is the only way to mutate. - When `value` is undefined, the component is uncontrolled — internal state seeded from `defaultValue` is used, and `onChange` (if given) is still notified. Dev-mode warns if a component switches between controlled and uncontrolled.

#### useCopyToClipboard
Source: `src/hooks/index.ts`
```ts
export function useCopyToClipboard(resetDelay: number = 2000): UseCopyToClipboardReturn
```
Copy to clipboard with success state that auto-resets.

#### useCountdown
Source: `src/hooks/useCountdown.ts`
```ts
export function useCountdown(
```
Live countdown to a future timestamp.

#### useDebounce
Source: `src/hooks/index.ts`
```ts
export function useDebounce<T>(value: T, delay: number = 300): T
```
Debounce a value.

#### useDebouncedCallback
Source: `src/hooks/useDebouncedCallback.ts`
```ts
export function useDebouncedCallback<A extends unknown[]>( fn: (...args: A) => void, delay: number ): DebouncedFn<A>
```
Debounce a function. Calls are coalesced — only the last invocation within `delay` ms runs (after the quiet window elapses). The returned function has `.cancel()` and `.flush()` helpers; also cancelled automatically on unmount.

#### useDerivedState
Source: `src/hooks/useDerivedState.ts`
```ts
export function useDerivedState<T>( derive: () => T, deps: readonly unknown[], isEqual: (prev: T, next: T) => boolean = Object.is ): T
```
Derive state from dependencies with explicit equality checking. Unlike `useMemo`, this stores the previous value and only triggers a re-render when the derived value actually changes according to `isEqual`.

#### useDisclosure
Source: `src/hooks/useDisclosure.ts`
```ts
export function useDisclosure(options: UseDisclosureOptions = {}): DisclosureState
```

#### useDocumentTitle
Source: `src/hooks/useDocumentTitle.ts`
```ts
export function useDocumentTitle( title: string, options?: UseDocumentTitleOptions ): void
```
Set the document title reactively. Supports a `%s` template and optional restore-on-unmount.

#### useElementSize
Source: `src/hooks/useElementSize.ts`
```ts
export function useElementSize<T extends Element>(ref: RefObject<T>): ResizeSize
```
Convenience wrapper over `useResizeObserver`.

#### useEscapeKey
Source: `src/hooks/useEscapeKey.ts`
```ts
export function useEscapeKey( handler: (e: KeyboardEvent) => void, enabled: boolean = true ): void
```
Fire `handler` when the user presses Escape. Handler identity changes are tracked — no re-subscription per render.

#### useEvent
Source: `src/hooks/useEvent.ts`
```ts
export function useEvent<A extends unknown[], R>( fn: (...args: A) => R ): (...args: A) => R
```
Stable callback ref that always sees the latest closure. Implements the React `useEvent` RFC: the returned function's identity never changes, but it always invokes the most-recent version of `fn`. Use when passing a callback to deeply-memoized children or to effects with restrictive dependency arrays.

#### useEventSource
Source: `src/hooks/useEventSource.ts`
```ts
export function useEventSource( url: string | null, options: UseEventSourceOptions = {} ): UseEventSourceReturn
```
Managed Server-Sent-Events (SSE) subscription. Auto-reconnects with exponential backoff; exposes `{ data, readyState, error, close }`. Pass `null` for `url` to pause the subscription.

#### useFieldArray
Source: `src/hooks/useFieldArray.ts`
```ts
export function useFieldArray< TForm extends FormValues, TKey extends keyof TForm & string, TItem = TForm[TKey] extends Array<infer U> ? U : never, >( form: UseFormReturn<TForm>, name: TKey ): UseFieldArrayReturn<TItem>
```
Manage a dynamic list of fields inside a `useForm` instance. @example const form = useForm({ initialValues: { addresses: [{ line1: "" }] } }); const addresses = useFieldArray(form, "addresses"); addresses.fields.map((addr, i) => ( <Input key={i} {...form.register(`addresses.${i}.line1`)} /> )); <Button onClick={() => addresses.append({ line1: "" })}>Add</Button>

#### useFocus
Source: `src/hooks/index.ts`
```ts
export function useFocus(): UseFocusReturn
```
Track focus state. Spread `bind` onto the target element.

#### useFocusReturn
Source: `src/hooks/useFocusReturn.ts`
```ts
export function useFocusReturn(enabled: boolean = true): void
```
Save the element that had focus when this hook first runs, and restore focus to it on unmount. Used by overlays (Modal, Drawer, Popover) for a11y: the user's focus returns to the trigger after the overlay closes. @param enabled Skip save/restore when false (for cleanly-dismounted overlays that shouldn't restore — e.g. when the trigger itself was removed).

#### useFocusVisible
Source: `src/hooks/useFocusVisible.ts`
```ts
export function useFocusVisible(): boolean
```
Global `:focus-visible` state: `true` when the last interaction was keyboard (or programmatic), `false` for mouse/touch. Matches browser `:focus-visible`. Subscribe once — the state is shared via bubbling DOM events.

#### useFocusWithin
Source: `src/hooks/useFocusWithin.ts`
```ts
export function useFocusWithin<T extends HTMLElement>(ref: RefObject<T>): boolean
```
`true` when any descendant of the element has focus.

#### useForceUpdate
Source: `src/hooks/index.ts`
```ts
export function useForceUpdate(): () => void
```
Force re-render.

#### useForm
Source: `src/hooks/useForm.ts`
```ts
export function useForm<T extends Record<string, unknown>>( options: UseFormOptions<T> ): UseFormReturn<T>
```
Controlled-or-uncontrolled form-state primitive with validation. Returns `{ values, errors, touched, register, handleSubmit, reset, setFieldValue, setFieldError, trigger }`. Pair with `useFieldArray` for dynamic rows and `FormErrorSummary` for a live error list.

#### useFullscreen
Source: `src/hooks/useFullscreen.ts`
```ts
export function useFullscreen( ref?: RefObject<Element | null> ): UseFullscreenReturn
```
Enter, exit, and toggle fullscreen mode.

#### useGeolocation
Source: `src/hooks/useGeolocation.ts`
```ts
export function useGeolocation( options: UseGeolocationOptions = {} ): GeolocationState
```
Track the user's geolocation via `navigator.geolocation`. Returns `{ coords, accuracy, timestamp, error, loading, requestPermission }`. SSR-safe: returns `{ loading: false, coords: null }` on the server.

#### useHasMounted
Source: `src/hooks/useHasMounted.ts`
```ts
export function useHasMounted(): boolean
```
Returns `false` during the first render, `true` after mount. Use to gate client-only content and avoid SSR hydration mismatches.

#### useHistoryState
Source: `src/hooks/useHistoryState.ts`
```ts
export function useHistoryState<T>( initialState: T, key: string = "__historyState" ): UseHistoryStateReturn<T>
```
Sync React state with the browser History API. State is namespaced under `key` inside `history.state` to avoid conflicts. SSR-safe — returns `initialState` and all methods are no-ops on the server.

#### useHover
Source: `src/hooks/index.ts`
```ts
export function useHover(): UseHoverReturn
```
Track hover state. Spread `bind` onto the target element.

#### useId
Source: `src/hooks/useId.ts`
```ts
export function useId(providedId?: string, prefix: string = "vf"): string
```
SSR-safe stable ID. Wraps React 18's `useId` with a Voidframe prefix convention so generated IDs are easy to spot in the DOM and DevTools. @param providedId If the consumer passes their own ID, use it verbatim. @param prefix Convention prefix (default `"vf"`).

#### useIdle
Source: `src/hooks/useIdle.ts`
```ts
export function useIdle(timeout: number): boolean
```
`true` when the user has been idle (no input events) for `timeout` ms.

#### useIntersectionObserver
Source: `src/hooks/useIntersectionObserver.ts`
```ts
export function useIntersectionObserver<T extends Element>( ref: RefObject<T>, options: UseIntersectionOptions = {} ): IntersectionState
```
Observe element intersection with the viewport (or a custom root).

#### useInterval
Source: `src/hooks/index.ts`
```ts
export function useInterval(callback: () => void, delay: number | null): void
```
Repeating interval with cleanup. @param delay `null` to pause.

#### useIsomorphicLayoutEffect
Source: `src/hooks/useIsomorphicLayoutEffect.ts`
```ts
useIsomorphicLayoutEffect = typeof window !== "undefined" ? useLayoutEffect : useEffect
```
`useLayoutEffect` on the client, `useEffect` on the server. Use in any hook that measures DOM (positioning, scroll, resize) so SSR doesn't print `useLayoutEffect does nothing on the server` warnings.

#### useKeyboardShortcut
Source: `src/hooks/index.ts`

Register a global keyboard shortcut.

#### useKeyPress

```ts

```
`true` while `key` (KeyboardEvent.key, case-insensitive) is pressed.

#### useList
Source: `src/hooks/useList.ts`
```ts
export function useList<T>(initialList?: T[]): UseListReturn<T>
```
Array-state helper: returns `{ list, set, push, pop, shift, unshift, insertAt, removeAt, updateAt, filter, sort, clear }`. Each mutator has a stable identity so passing them into memoised children doesn't churn props.

#### useLocalStorage

Persist state in localStorage.

#### useLockBodyScroll

Lock body scroll by setting `overflow: hidden` on `document.body`. Restores original overflow on unlock or unmount. SSR-safe.

#### useLongPress

#### useMap

Map-state helper: returns `{ map, set, delete, clear, has, get, entries }`. Identity of `map` updates on every change so React sees a new reference.

#### useMediaQuery

Responsive media query hook. @param query e.g. `"(max-width: 768px)"`

#### useMergedRefs
Source: `src/hooks/useMergedRefs.ts`
```ts
export function useMergedRefs<T>( ...refs: Array<Ref<T> | undefined | null> ): RefCallback<T>
```
Merge multiple refs into one. Apply when a component has its own internal ref AND forwards a ref AND optionally merges a child's ref (via `<Slot>`). Each ref can be a callback, an object ref, or null/undefined (skipped). @example const internal = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null); const setRef = useMergedRefs(internal, forwardedRef); return <div ref={setRef} />;

#### useMountEffect

```ts
export function useMountEffect(effect: EffectCallback): void
```
Runs `effect` once when the component mounts. Cleanup runs on unmount. Equivalent to `useEffect(fn, [])` but communicates intent.

#### useMutationObserver

Observe DOM mutations on a ref'd element. Uses `useRef` to store the latest callback so the observer doesn't need to be re-created on every render.

Track device orientation via the Screen Orientation API. Falls back to comparing `innerWidth`/`innerHeight` when the API is unavailable. SSR-safe — returns portrait defaults with `isSupported: false`.

Wrap `navigator.permissions.query({ name })`. Returns `{ state: "granted" | "denied" | "prompt" | "unsupported" }` and re-evaluates on `change` events.

Track the user's preferred language(s) via `navigator.language`. Listens for the `languagechange` event to stay in sync. SSR-safe — defaults to `"en"`.

Repeating callback driven by `requestAnimationFrame`. Fires at most once per `ms` milliseconds (defaults to every frame). Use for scroll/animation loops where visual fidelity matters more than timer precision. Pass `null` to pause.

Throttle a value. The returned value updates at most once per `interval` ms.

#### useThrottledCallback
Source: `src/hooks/useThrottledCallback.ts`
```ts
export function useThrottledCallback<A extends unknown[]>( fn: (...args: A) => void, interval: number, options: { leading?: boolean; trailing?: boolean } = {} ): (...args: A) => void
```
Throttle a function. Call at most once every `interval` ms. Leading-edge: the first call fires immediately; subsequent calls within the interval are dropped (or held as "trailing" — see `trailing`).

Fire `callback` after `delay` ms. Pass `null` to pause. Callback identity changes are handled — the ref is always kept current.

#### composeEventHandlers
Source: `src/utils/composeEventHandlers.ts`

Compose event handlers. If any handler calls `event.preventDefault()`, subsequent handlers are skipped.

#### composeEventHandlersAlways
Source: `src/utils/composeEventHandlers.ts`


#### computeAnchoredPosition
Source: `src/utils/anchor.ts`
```ts
export function computeAnchoredPosition( triggerRect: AnchorRect, contentSize: AnchorSize, placement: Placement, offset: number ): AnchorPosition
```
Compute the pixel top/left for a floating element anchored to a trigger. Behavior: - `placement` picks the primary side and alignment (e.g. `"bottom-start"`). - If the chosen side overflows the viewport, flips to the opposite side. - After placement, clamps the position 8px inside the viewport on both axes.

Tiny token-based formatter. Supported tokens: yyyy 4-digit year yy 2-digit year MM 2-digit month M 1-2 digit month dd 2-digit day d 1-2 digit day HH 2-digit hour (24h) H 1-2 digit hour (24h) hh 2-digit hour (12h) h 1-2 digit hour (12h) mm 2-digit minute m 1-2 digit minute ss 2-digit second a AM/PM For richer locale-aware formatting, prefer `Intl.DateTimeFormat` directly or pass a `(d) => string` function at the call site.

```ts
isDev: boolean = typeof process !== "undefined" && process.env.NODE_ENV === "development"
```
`true` when NODE_ENV is "development".

#### luminance
Source: `src/utils/color.ts`

#### mergeStyles
Source: `src/utils/mergeStyles.ts`
```ts
export function mergeStyles( ...styles: (CSSProperties | undefined | null | false)[] ): CSSProperties
```
Merge multiple CSSProperties objects. Later values override earlier ones, but explicit `undefined` values are skipped (won't erase existing keys). @example mergeStyles({ color: "red" }, condition && { fontWeight: "bold" })

#### mix
Source: `src/utils/color.ts`
```ts
export function mix(color1: string, color2: string, weight: number = 0.5): string
```
Mix two hex colors by weight (0-1, default 0.5). Weight 0 = all color2, weight 1 = all color1.

#### parseColor
Source: `src/utils/color.ts`
```ts
export function parseColor( input: string ): { r: number; g: number; b: number; a: number } | null
```
Parse any common CSS color format to RGBA. Supports: #hex (3/6/8 digit), rgb(), rgba(), hsl(), hsla(). Named colors are NOT supported.

#### parseDate
Source: `src/utils/date.ts`
```ts
export function parseDate(input: string, pattern: string): Date | null
```
Parse a date string against a pattern using the same token set as `formatDate`. Returns `null` on failure.

Release a portal container. Decrements the ref count and removes the element from the DOM when it reaches zero.

#### responsiveClasses
Source: `src/utils/responsiveClasses.ts`
```ts
export function responsiveClasses<T extends string>( prefix: string, value: T | Partial<Record<string, T>>, ): string
```
Generate responsive utility classes from a plain value or a breakpoint-keyed object. @example responsiveClasses("cols", "2") // "vf-cols-2" responsiveClasses("cols", { base: "1", md: "2", lg: "3" }) // "vf-cols-1 md:vf-cols-2 lg:vf-cols-3"

#### rgbToHsl
Source: `src/utils/color.ts`
```ts
export function rgbToHsl( r: number, g: number, b: number ): { h: number; s: number; l: number }
```
Convert RGB (0-255) to HSL (h: 0-360, s: 0-100, l: 0-100).

#### safeHref
Source: `src/utils/safeHref.ts`
```ts
export function safeHref( url: unknown, options: SafeHrefOptions = {} ): string
```
Returns the URL if it's safe to render in an `href`/`src` attribute, otherwise returns `fallback` (default `"#"`). Safe inputs: - `http(s)://…` - `mailto:…`, `tel:…`, `sms:…` - relative paths (`/foo`, `./x`, `../y`), query fragments (`?q=1`), and in-page hash links (`#main`) - empty string (passes through unchanged — consumers often use "" as a no-op) Unsafe inputs (returns fallback): - `javascript:…`, `data:…`, `vbscript:…`, `file:…`, etc. - Whitespace-prefixed schemes that the browser would tolerate (e.g. ` javascript:…`) - Anything non-string

#### safeHrefOrWarn
Source: `src/utils/safeHref.ts`
```ts
export function safeHrefOrWarn( url: unknown, component: string, options: SafeHrefOptions = {} ): string
```
Same as `safeHref` but throws a dev warning when rejecting. Intended for places where the consumer is passing untrusted data and we want to surface the attempt rather than silently fall back.

#### sanitizeHtml
Source: `src/utils/sanitizeHtml.ts`
```ts
export function sanitizeHtml( html: string, profile: SanitizeProfile = "rich-text" ): string
```
Sanitize an HTML string against one of the built-in allowlists. Returns the empty string in SSR / non-browser contexts — callers should treat the output as client-only.

#### toneAttrs
Source: `src/utils/toneAttrs.ts`
```ts
export function toneAttrs(base: string, input: ToneAttrsInput = {}): ToneAttrs
```
Build a combined BEM class list + `data-*` attribute object from tone/variant/size props. Emits both representations so consumers can target either. @param base BEM base class (e.g. `"vf-stat"`). Always included. @param input Tone/variant/size values. Undefined values are omitted.

#### truncate

```ts
export function truncate(str: string | null | undefined, max: number = 40): string
```
Truncate string with ellipsis.

#### uid
Source: `src/utils/formatters.ts`
```ts
export function uid(prefix: string = "vf"): string
```
Generate a short unique ID (monotonic counter, prefixed). Intended for **internal-only** non-rendered identifiers — e.g. module-level cache keys, dev-warning de-dup keys, transient state lookups. The randomness comes from `Math.random()` which is **not SSR-safe**; if you place the result in the DOM, server and client will mismatch on hydration. For DOM-rendered identifiers (id, htmlFor, aria-labelledby, list keys that touch the DOM), use React's `useId()` hook instead. @param prefix Default `"vf"`.

#### valibotAdapter
Source: `src/utils/formValidation.ts`
```ts
export function valibotAdapter<T>( schema: unknown, safeParse: ( schema: unknown, data: T ) =>
```
Adapt a Valibot schema to voidframe's FormValidator interface. Takes the schema object and the safeParse function separately (Valibot uses a functional API).

#### warn
Source: `src/utils/warn.ts`
```ts
export function warn(condition: boolean, message: string, ...args: unknown[]): void
```
Warn in development if `condition` is false. Production: noop. @param condition When false, the warning fires. @param message Human-readable explanation. Should name the component and the fix.

#### warnOnce
Source: `src/utils/warn.ts`
```ts
export function warnOnce(key: string, message: string, ...args: unknown[]): void
```
Warn at most once per `key`. For deprecation notices, missing-context errors, etc. that would otherwise spam the console.
